title: Portify Canonical Design Tokens
description: Machine-readable canonical design tokens. Tranche 1A/1A.1/1A.2 scope: color, radius and spacing. COLOR is generated from 10-design/DESIGN-SYSTEM/RUNTIME/portify-shared.css (the file the closed neutral-palette decision, PDS-017/033, is actually bound to in live canon); RADIUS is generated from 10-design/DESIGN-SYSTEM/CANONICAL-RADIUS-DECISIONS.json (only the radius values that trace to a closed PDS decision); SPACING is generated from 10-design/DESIGN-SYSTEM/CANONICAL-SPACING-DECISIONS.json (Product Owner-approved Option 3B, 2026-09-02 — a closed 10-value primitive set, see the Tranche 1A.2 governance record §14). Neither the color nor the radius source has a primitive/alias layer, so this artifact has no top-level 'primitive' key — every semantic color value is already final. Tranche 2A.1 adds an OPTIONAL 'typography' domain, generated from 10-design/DESIGN-SYSTEM/CANONICAL-TYPOGRAPHY-DECISIONS.json (Product Owner-approved TYPO-001..012, 2026-09-15 — see 03-decisions/UX/TYPOGRAPHY-V1-DECISIONS.md). 'typography' is deliberately NOT in the top-level 'required' list — a pre-2A.1 artifact without it remains valid against this schema (additive, non-breaking); once present, its own required/additionalProperties:false sub-shape makes the full family/style/role contract mandatory, never partial.

domainsIncluded.description: Which token domains this specific artifact actually populates with real values. A domain absent here has no canonical values yet and must never be filled with fabricated or borrowed-from-a-non-canonical-source data.

semantic.description: Theme-dependent semantic color tokens, fully resolved to concrete hex/rgba values (no var() references — this artifact is meant to be consumed directly, not re-resolved).

radius.description: Theme-independent corner-radius tokens. Only values that trace to an explicitly closed PDS decision — not a general-purpose scale.

spacing.description: Theme-independent spacing tokens. Product Owner-approved v1 (Option 3B, 2026-09-02): a closed 10-value primitive set plus an optional, currently-empty semantic-alias layer. 'primitive' values are restricted by enum to exactly the approved set — an unapproved value fails closed at validation, not just at generation time.

primitive.description: The approved v1 spacing primitives. Closed set — do not add a value here without another canonical Design System decision.

semantic.description: Semantic spacing aliases. Empty in the v1 decision — no candidate currently meets ONLY_STABLE_CROSS_SYSTEM_MEANINGS. Present as an object (not absent) so a future decision can populate it without a breaking schema change.

typography.description: OPTIONAL. Typography v1 (TYPO-001..012, Product Owner-approved 2026-09-15). Two-layer model: 'family' (which font), 'style' (the PDS-061/062 real-font-validated render contract per slot), 'role' (BTM-014's semantic roles mapped onto style slots, per TYPO-001). Absent entirely in a pre-2A.1 artifact; once present, every sub-key below is mandatory — this schema validates contract SHAPE and representation only, never duplicating canonical VALUES already owned by CANONICAL-TYPOGRAPHY-DECISIONS.json.

family.description: The two approved Typography v1 families (TYPO-003). Closed set — do not add a key here without another canonical Typography decision.

style.description: The 13 approved Typography v1 style slots (TYPO-002/004/005/006/007), each a PDS-061/062-derived render contract. Closed set.

role.description: The 9 approved BTM-014 semantic roles (TYPO-001), each mapped to one of the 13 style slots above. titleMd, label (style-slot), numericSecondary and numericInline are valid style slots deliberately absent here — not every slot has a semantic-role mapping in v1. Closed set.

typographyFamily.description: A single family entry — the literal font-family name only. No fallback stack (that stays consumer/runtime-owned, TYPO-003).

typographyStyleSlot.description: One style slot's render contract. Representation only (TYPO-010): fontSize/lineHeight as px-strings, letterSpacing as an em-string, fontWeight as a numeric CSS weight. Exact v1 values are owned by CANONICAL-TYPOGRAPHY-DECISIONS.json, not restated here as schema const.

typographyStyleSlotRef.description: A semantic role's value must reference one of the 13 approved style slots by name — referential integrity, not a duplicated value.
